reason: B is the stronger proposal because W–P bonding and the demonstrated W-induced increase in crystallization onset temperatures in a related Fe–P amorphous alloy provide a material-specific mechanism that directly targets reheating stability, with defined cooling rates, composition series, and falsifiable phase/DSC outcomes. A relies mainly on a generic atomic-size-mismatch argument and provides no direct evidence that B improves thermal stability in a comparable P-rich system.
